title: Quick Support
description: Remote access to computers without the agent installed. Ask the user to run the Quick Support executable and type the code it shows.
codeHint: 9 digit code shown on the remote computer
downloadClientTooltip: Generic executable for any customer. Every time it runs it shows a new code. Nothing is installed on the remote computer.
endSessionConfirm: End the quick support session {code} on {hostname}? The remote computer will be disconnected.
connectFailed: Unable to connect to the remote computer

settings.description: Settings of the Quick Support executable (remote access without installing the agent). Computers connect to a dedicated MeshCentral device group and are removed automatically when the executable is closed.
settings.clientMissing: The Quick Support executable was not found on the server. Build it from the QuickSupport project (build.ps1) and copy trmm-quicksupport.exe to the server's private/exe folder.
settings.requireConsent: Ask the user to allow each connection
settings.requireConsentHint: When disabled the user is only notified (running the executable is the consent).
settings.resetTokenTooltip: Generates a new token. Executables downloaded before will stop working.
settings.resetTokenConfirm: Executables already downloaded will stop working and must be downloaded again. Continue?
settings.tokenReset: Token reset. Download the executable again.
settings.showPrivacyBar: Show privacy bar on the remote computer
settings.showPrivacyBarHint: Bar at the top of the remote screen showing that it is being accessed, with a button to disconnect.
settings.showNotification: Notify the remote user when a session starts
settings.showNotificationHint: Windows notification on the remote computer when the technician opens the desktop, terminal or files. The quick support window always shows the technician that is connected.

install.agentOnly: Installs the Tactical RMM agent (with MeshCentral) on the computer.
install.approvedNotify: Installation approved. It starts on the remote computer after the user confirms.
install.pending: {count} permanent access request(s) waiting for approval
